player_prompt.intro:
I ni ce ka kɛlɛ! Frozen Lake ɲɛ!

Kɛlɛ 'P' ɲɛ cɛ ka kɔrɔ bɛɛ.
Kɔrɔ sɛmɛ:
  ' ' = Kɔrɔ bɛɛ (kɔrɔ dɔɔnin bɛɛ)
  'H' = Kɔlɔ (kɔlɔ dɔɔnin bɛɛ, i ka kɛlɛ kɛ!)
  'G' = Kɛlɛ bɛɛ (i ni kɛlɛ kɛ ka kɔrɔ bɛɛ!)
  'P' = Kɛlɛ kɔrɔ bɛɛ

Kɛlɛ kɔrɔ sɛmɛ: kɔrɔ kɛnɛ, kɔrɔ bɔ, kɔrɔ kɔ, kɔrɔ dɔ (walima w, a, s, d)
Kɛlɛ kɔrɔ sɛmɛ kɛ: [up], [down], [left], [right] walima [w], [a], [s], [d]

Kɛlɛ bɛɛ: I ni kɛlɛ kɛ ka kɔrɔ bɛɛ kɔrɔ kɔnɔ (kɔrɔ kɛnɛ) ka kɛlɛ bɛɛ kɔrɔ dɔ (kɔrɔ bɔ) kɔlɔ kɔnɔ!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kɛlɛ kɔrɔ sɛmɛ dɔɔnin bɛɛ. Kɛlɛ [up], [down], [left], [right] walima [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: An tɛ a lɔn '{action}'. I ka baara kɛ ni sanfɛ, duguma, numanbolo la, kinibolo la walima w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: I tuui kɔɔcɩ {action} nɛ i kɛ kɛ wall!

outcome.win: I sera i ka laɲinita ma!
outcome.fell_in_hole: I benna dingɛ kɔnɔ! Ɲɔgɔndan banna. I ye {pct}% ta kɛ ka se a laɲini ma.
outcome.turn_limit: I sera i ka filenw na! Ɲɛnamaya banna. I ye {pct}% ta kɛ walisa k'i seen don o laɲinita la.
